  • • Modem – converts digital to analog signals
  • • Router – directs data between networks
  • • Switch – connects devices in a network
  • • Network cables – wired communication
  • • Wireless devices – Wi-Fi adapters

  • • Data transfer between systems
  • • Supports communication networks
